    visit(LeaveCommand) - Method in class network.server.core.LobbyManager
    Handles a leave request, branching on the player's state: in a finished game (END_OF_GAME): forwards the command to the session queue (the controller cleans up the model), removes the entry from LobbyManager.activeGames, and — once no connected player remains in that session — drops any leftover (disconnected) entries and shuts the controller down, off-loading the blocking join to shutdown-executor; in a lobby (pre-game): handled locally by LobbyManager.handleLeaveFromLobby(String) (the model is not touched); in game or browsing: an error is sent back to the player.
    visit(LeaveCommand) - Method in interface shared.command.lobbyCommand.LobbyCommandVisitor
